result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of layout issues caused by horizontal clipping and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge. A partial category chip and a partially visible third restaurant card appear without an obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly scrollable horizontal carousel with consistent clipping and scroll indicators, or ensure the row does not extend beyond the viewport unexpectedly.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, obscuring the bottom portion of its image and potentially its content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so the final cards can be viewed fully above the navigation bar.
